name: Dr. Latha Ramalingam
about: Dr. Latha Ramalingam is a Radiation Oncologist and Radiologist in Kengeri, Bangalore and has an experience of 24 years in these fields. Dr. Mathangi J practices at BGS Gleneagles Global Hospital in Kengeri, Bangalore. She completed MBBS from Stanley Medical College & Hospital , Chennai in 1998,DNB - Radiotherapy from Apollo cancer speciality hospital, chennai in 2009 and Diploma in Radio Therapy from The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University (TNMGRMU) in 2006.She is a member of European Society for Radiotherapy & Oncology (ESTRO),American Society for Therapeutic Oncology (ASTRO),Association of Radiation Oncologists of India (AROI) and European Society of Medical Oncology (ESMO). Some of the services provided by the doctor are: Treatment of Lung cancers,Treatment of GI cancers - Esophagus, rectum,Stereotactic body ablative radiotherapy (SBRT),Intensity modulated Radiotherapy ( IMRT) and Women cancer management - Breast and cervix etc.
